# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and analysis documents generated during assessment.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md): Two-layer system and component interaction diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md): Categorized dependency visualization and compatibility notes.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md): API surface, service communication patterns, and sequence flow.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md): Persistence model, entity relationships, and data boundary analysis.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md): Configuration sources, profiles, and sensitive setting inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md): Core domain workflows, rules, and business sequence.
